# directus_dashboard (Resource)

Manages a Directus Insights dashboard (directus_dashboards).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the dashboard.

### Optional

- `color` (String) Accent color (hex) for the dashboard.
- `icon` (String) Material icon name for the dashboard.
- `note` (String) Description shown in the app.

### Read-Only

- `date_created` (String) Timestamp when the dashboard was created.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned dashboard UUID.
- `user_created` (String) UUID of the user who created the dashboard.
